summary: Capture recipe semantics once and prepare complete recipe facts only when needed.
details: Share one Context-owned recipe source and query indexes across matching, relationships, risk analysis and coverage instead of forcing a complete RecipeFacts representation for every consumer.

Preserve complete schema-2 inspection exports, defensive copies, detached route callbacks and actual emission checks. Dynamic, metatable-backed and duplicate-key inputs retain the established generic conversion behavior.

Focused tests retain compiled decisions, emitted definitions and public recipe exports. Current-package migrations and responsive-menu performance remain separate acceptance requirements; no loading-speed improvement is claimed yet.
